definitions.explanation: A wound caused by a sharp object such as a knife, glass, or paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a cut on my finger with a kitchen knife.

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}して→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧エイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I disinfected the cut and put on a bandage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧{切|き}り{傷|きず}なら⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧。
examples.english: A shallow cut will heal quickly.

notes:
A compound of {切|き}り (cutting) + ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧ (wound). Refers specifically to wounds made by sharp objects like knives, glass, or paper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to sustain a cut
- {切|き}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to treat a cut
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧/⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧{切|き}り{傷|きず}: deep/shallow cut
- {切|き}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧: to disinfect a cut

OTHER WOUND TYPES:
- ⟦{擦|す}り{傷|きず}→擦り傷：08197_surikizu⟧: scrape, abrasion
- ⟦{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}→刺し傷：15907_sashikizu⟧: stab wound
- {打撲傷|だぼくしょう}: bruise, contusion
- や⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: burn
- {噛|か}み{傷|きず}: bite wound
